issues.detail: The Vietnamese adds 'Đức Giê-hô-va phán' (The LORD says), which has no basis in the Hebrew text. The Hebrew begins with 'לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר' (For the choir director, for the sons of Korah, a psalm), then 'שִׁמְעוּ זֹאת כָּל הָעַמִּים' (Hear this, all peoples). The phrase 'Đức Giê-hô-va phán' is an addition not present in the Hebrew and changes the verse's claim by attributing the speech to the LORD.
